title: Tonight I'm livestreaming my game that I built in Codex.
author: Camenwolf
selftext:
Hopefully I'm allowed to post a livestream here.  I don't see where the rules specifically say not to.  This is a game I built entirely in Codex using 5.5, 5.6 Sol, and 6 Astra on the Phaser 3.90.0 platform.  I've been working on it for a long time and the models changed over time.

It's not going to blow you away with mind boggling graphics or anything, but I think it's a fun, interesting, fairly unique zero gravity physics puzzle game.  It's browser based, supports mobile, and free to play.  No ads or anything.  I'm just trying to get people play it and tell me what they think.

You can try the game here:  
[https://melodythegame.com](https://melodythegame.com)

And I'd love to see you on the livestream tonight where I can talk about the codex development process if you want.

comments.author: Top_Purchase4091
comments.body: I tried a few levels but its honestly just kind of boring. There is no mechanic or anything that would make me go "this is interesting".

replies.author: Camenwolf
replies.body: It's definitely not for everyone.  It's a meant to be a low stimulation, zen game, designed to reward patience and methodical play.  Admittedly not what most gamers are looking for.  But I really appreciate you checking it out.
